features.name: Scenario navigation list
features.description: Left-hand list exposing the two scenarios ('1) Find best time', '2) Display full forecast'). Selecting an item swaps the content pane.
expected_behaviour: Both scenario titles appear verbatim in the navigation list
Selecting a scenario navigates to its page and updates the content pane

features.name: Find best time computation
features.description: Scenario 1 page: 'Hours to look ahead' TextBox (default 12), 'Restrict to low user experience impact' CheckBox (checked), 'Find best time' Button, and Best time / Lowest severity output Runs. Clicking the button calls PowerGridForecast.GetForecast() on a background thread and either reports the best time+severity or, if no good time is found (or the forecast is empty), the status 'Unable to find a good time to do work'.
expected_behaviour: CheckBox 'Restrict to low user experience impact' is present and checked by default
Clicking 'Find best time' produces a visible response (best time+severity OR the 'Unable to find a good time to do work' status)
Best time / Lowest severity output labels are present

features.name: Full forecast list
features.description: Scenario 2 page: 'Get forecast' Button and a ForecastList (ListView). Clicking the button calls PowerGridForecast.GetForecast(); if the forecast is empty it shows the status 'No forecast available. Try again later.', otherwise it fills the list with Date/Time, Severity, Low impact? rows plus start time and block duration.
expected_behaviour: Clicking 'Get forecast' produces a visible response (populated forecast list OR the 'No forecast available. Try again later.' status)
Forecast start time / block duration output labels are present
